evidence:
Agent side: task.toml sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate", so the verifier is a different image/container. The agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile) installs only node:22 + git/procps/sqlite3 and express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, and copies only 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'. No tests/, solution/, judge CLI (claude-code/codex), Playwright MCP or harbor-rewardkit is present in the agent image. environment/instructions holds only hireops_rules.md and integration.md; environment/assets holds only seed_data.json. A grep of environment/ and instruction.md for criteri|rubric|judge|reward|grader|scor returned nothing, and a 12-word-ngram overlap check between all 55 criterion descriptions in tests/*/*/judge.toml and instruction.md + hireops_rules.md found 0 verbatim overlaps, so the rubric is not reproduced in the agent's world (the brief states public product requirements, which is intended). Verifier side: criteria, prompts, scoring.toml and score.py exist only in tests/, copied by tests/Dockerfile 'COPY . /tests' then 'RUN chmod +x /tests/test.sh && chmod -R go-rwx /tests'; test.sh:12 repeats 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests', test.sh:3 'umask 077', test.sh:11 'chmod 700 "$LOG_DIR"'. The submitted app is started at test.sh:104-111 with 'setsid env -i ... setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node "$APP_ENTRY"', i.e. as nobody with a scrubbed environment (no ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/REWARDKIT vars), so it cannot read /tests (root-only), cannot write $LOG_DIR/reward.txt or reward.json (700 root), and cannot tamper with $LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh (root-owned inside the 700 dir) that the judge's restart MCP invokes. test.sh:60 writes a zero reward first and cleanup/ensure_reward keeps it on every exit; final reward is computed by root-run score.py (test.sh:217,227) from RewardKit outputs, not from anything the app writes. Submission-to-verifier transfer: test.sh:72-83 rejects any symlink in /app except ones under /app/node_modules resolving inside it, preventing link tricks toward /tests or /logs before the root chown/cp at lines 85-95. All of tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, environment/Dockerfile, tests/tools/score.py and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical (CRLF-normalised diff) to the frozen template, so isolation is template-controlled and unchanged by this task. Raw-evidence index (hashes verified) records the scripted golden ran in the verifier image as uid 65534, consistent with the privilege drop, though it is not a configured judge run.

Adversarial probes: (1) Broken app that could pass by reading criteria: at agent time no criteria exist in its container; at grade time it runs as uid 65534 with /tests mode go-rwx, so it cannot open judge.toml/prompt.md. (2) Broken app that writes reward.txt=1.0: $LOG_DIR is 0700 root, write fails; test.sh/score.py overwrite reward anyway. (3) App that ships a symlink /app/x -> /logs/verifier/reward.txt hoping root cp/chown follows it: test.sh:72-83 exits with zero reward. (4) Conforming alternative that could fail due to this isolation: an app needing to write its DB works because /app (or the /tmp/submission copy) is chowned to 65534 and DB_PATH passed; nothing in the isolation penalises a conforming app.

Latent, unmeasured P3 note (not a defect, template-controlled): /proc is not mounted hidepid, so the nobody-run app could read world-readable /proc/<pid>/cmdline of root processes during grading; if RewardKit passes the judge prompt (with criteria) as a CLI argument to claude-code, criteria text would be visible to the running app. RewardKit 0.1.7 source is not in the workspace, so this was not verified; it would require a deliberately adversarial submission and affects every template task equally. Prompt injection via UI content is row 45's scope, not this row.
